metadata_contract: only source null/absent -> access_key; all other raw fields and field sets match exactly
source_basis: official examples show six-digit REST and nine-digit trade-update order timestamps; exact retained capture shows submicrosecond REST rounding. This is a narrow representation contract, not a vendor latency/precision SLA.
timestamp_contract: exact nanoseconds or 7–9 fractional digits rounded HALF_UP to a six-digit microsecond grid; same-precision differences still reject; no millisecond/second tolerance
